scope: Runtime handling of the new CPU cooler slot and bounded failure recovery; no new 3D assets

findings.problem: The component inspector omitted CPU coolers, although the selection count included them.
findings.change: CPU coolers now have an accessible inspect button and a clear no-model message. The exact selection remains in the parts list.

findings.problem: An unexpected model for a new category could reach an undefined layout and throw while constructing its position.
findings.change: The renderer reports unsupported categories as unplaced before downloading or cloning geometry. It does not invent cooler dimensions, placement or a substitute model.

findings.problem: The controller looked up models by ID alone and did not separately enforce model category.
findings.change: Both controller and renderer enforce exact selected ID, category and local-library GLB path. Duplicate or malformed library responses cannot initialize the renderer.

findings.problem: A fire-and-forget scene refresh could reject without recovery, or access a disposed scene after pagehide.
findings.change: Refresh failures show a retry path; delayed scene initialization and updates are ignored after disposal. Existing parts and compatibility checks remain available.

findings.problem: Opening a selection containing no renderable model still initialized the graphics engine.
findings.change: Explicit opening checks coverage first. With no renderable models, Three.js and GLB loading do not start. The unavailable state remains usable without WebGL.

preserved: 105 existing downloaded-model mappings and creator/license records
Existing local assets and geometry; no assets downloaded, relabeled or substituted
Touch, keyboard, camera presets, zoom, exploded view and quality controls
Lazy loading after explicit user action
Creator-credit links and distinct appearance descriptions
Builder selections, storage and compatibility remain independent of renderer failure

verification.method: VM controller tests with mocked network/module boundaries; renderer tests use real Three.js geometry, vectors and bounds with a mocked WebGL renderer and GLB loader.
verification.browserVisualQA: Not performed by this subtask. Parent release QA must inspect desktop/mobile real rendering.
